topic: Dashboard network bug fix and performance
summary_markdown:
The clusterization frequency formula for dashboards was deployed to staging, but it is running slower due to complex query requirements and the disabling of certain optimizations. A plan is in place to address this performance issue using caching later.

Separately, a network bug affecting the dashboards was identified. While [me] initially stated the bug was on the dashboards, they confirmed fixing it in version 9.02 within the develop environment. A hotfix for production deployment is scheduled for Friday.
decisions: A hotfix for the dashboard network issue will be deployed to production this Friday.
action_items: Implement caching to improve performance of the clusterization frequency formula on dashboards.
